hypothesis: Frozen initial normal latent distillation and new-normal centroid alignment may preserve normal geometry
loss: Original norm SAE loss +.1 normalized squared latent error on old replay normals. Alignment arms additionally +.05 normalized squared new-normal latent distance to frozen old-normal centroid; teacher scale floor .01.
device: Sequential GPU, same device/core/initial cache/seed and budget as matched main30 replay controls
budget: Same update20epoch/6round cap256, memory128, batch12, lr1e-5, gradclip5, MSEAvg/shared model/original stops
controls: Reuse matched main30 replay, safe_replay and new_only only after exact core/initial/input/participant proof; no extra favorable-seed selection
prior: Coefficients came from earlier exploratory V3 separate PCA-split trials; no current final features used to choose them. Inspired by latent distillation, not a claim of exact LwF reproduction or a novel loss.
resource_change: Heavy parallel CPU training was rejected by preflight: 31.14GiB total RAM, 2.71GiB available. No such CPU study was started.
